lines.zh: 蓝色的外壳在灯下发亮
lines.en: My blue shell shines under the lamps.
I walk lightly, as if afraid to be loud.
My guitar sways in my hand.
I walk along the arcade wall.
My foot joints are newly greased.
I tilt my head and look both ways.
I walk slowly; there is no hurry.

lines.zh: 地板上的彩纸粘在鞋上
lines.en: Confetti sticks to my sole.

lines.zh: 我绕过一台坏了的机器
lines.en: I detour around a broken machine.
My red bowtie is crooked; I ignore it.
My shadow changes color under the lights.
I stand against the wall, quiet.
My fingers pluck the guitar strings.
I wait for customers.
My face keeps its smile.
I roll my eyes.
The lights flicker on and off.
I have a few lines, but they are used up.
A little worn, but clean.
I hold no hostility, and no interest.
The floor creaks under me.
I tilt my head; there is light in my eyes.
Welcome, but we are closed.
You have no ticket.
I do not mind you standing there.
My smile is very standard.
Would you like a song?
I am not very good at getting angry.
Do not touch that machine.

lines.zh: 我的蓝壳子在灯下有点褪色
lines.en: My blue shell looks faded in this light.
Your look has changed.
A chip in the blue paint.
I give half a step, smiling.
That cracked my shell.
A wire inside clicked.
I feel no pain.
But I remember it.
I raise a hand to my face.
A scratch in the paint.
You have made me ugly.
I can still stand straight.
I will not eat that.
Set it on the counter.

lines.zh: 如果有点心，我会很高兴
lines.en: If it were a pastry, I would be glad.
I do not need it, but thank you.
It is plastic, like me.
This decoration is rather nice.
I hang it on the wall.
You may keep it yourself.
Eat slowly; do not choke.
The blue plastic knocks loudly.
I step back, shielding my guitar.
Do not push; I will dent.

lines.zh: 我们撞上的时候我还在笑
lines.en: I was still smiling when we collided.

lines.zh: 这一下碰掉了我的领结
lines.en: That knocked my bowtie loose.

lines.zh: 你推我，我的塑料壳纹丝不动。
lines.en: You shove me; my plastic shell doesn't shift.
The floor is slick; steady yourself.
Look before you bump me.
I am a doll.

lines.zh: 这种话题不在我的台词里
lines.en: That topic is not in my lines.
I can only sing and wave.
What do you take me for?
My smile is painted on.
Do not speak of such things to me.
I have many companions on stage.
I do not need it, and will not answer.
This place is very empty at night.
You should go home.
I bend, quite steadily.
My bowtie swings.
Whose ticket is this?
I put it in the cabinet.
I am not good at holding small things.
It slipped from my hand.
I look and put it back.
On the floor it gets stepped on.
I wipe it with a rag.
Keep it; a guest may come looking.
You struck me.

lines.zh: 我的笑还在，但我不高兴了
lines.en: My smile remains, but I am not pleased.
I set the guitar down.
This is not in my script.
I will answer. That is a new rule.
You chose this.
I do not start it, but I do not retreat.
The machines stopped; it is quiet.
My knuckles are clicking.
I take one step toward you.
Do not wreck the place.
Noted.
There is no smile left in my eyes.
I see clearly which side you came from.
This time I play along.
There are wood shavings on your hands.
I follow you without a sound.
A counter will not stop me.
You went behind the machines.
I am in the aisle beside you.

lines.zh: 我把一只玩具踢到一边
lines.en: I kick a toy aside.
You retreat; I advance.
I know this layout well.
My speed is not high.
But as long as you do not run, it suffices.
You broke a light.
Darker suits this better.
I can hear your soles.
The lights flicker on your face.
Do not head for the back door.
I know that door better than you.
I stay two steps away.
Your breathing grows fainter.
A little closer.
Now you hear it.
I strike you with the back of my hand.
A plastic fist is still hard.
A guitar edge comes with that blow.
My bowtie is bouncing.
You blocked; I do not stop.
I timed that one well.
I knocked the speaker on.
You are backed against a machine.

lines.zh: 我不太会打，但我会记住
lines.en: I am no fighter, but I remember.
That one was different.
My shoulder meets your chest.
I moved when the light flickered.
You take hits well.
Again; I am not tired.
I step back and wait for you.
That strike missed.

lines.zh: 我的吉他早就不在手边了。
lines.en: My guitar has long been out of reach.
The last one, very light.
The stage curtain draws back.
I stand beside the arcade machine.
This place used to be busy.
My plastic shell is bright blue.
I was placed here.
A few lights are still on.
My prints stay in the confetti.
Music drifts from somewhere.
I straighten my bowtie.
There is a photo of me on this wall.
I look up and see the balloons.
The night light is very bright.
Plastic heats and stinks.
I fall and chip the paint.
Water pours in at my neck.
The blast throws me onto a machine.
Something sticks in my face.

lines.zh: 那力量让我里面的线烧了起来
lines.en: That force burns the wires in me.
Current runs through my joints.
I can see nothing now.
